prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1's exact eight-frame Borrin ledger review sheet into an ACTOR layer for an independently rendered desk. Retain all EIGHT distinct ordered poses in the SAME four-column/two-row layout. Keep Borrin's head, spectacles, two short grey beard braids, swept-grey hair, red cravat, embroidered dark waistcoat, cream shirt, sleeves, hands, pointing fingers and camera. Remove ONLY the entire wooden desk, drawers, legs, ledger, inkwell, quill and stacked books from every cell, leaving genuine transparency. Keep Borrin seated on his own wooden chair. Reveal his trousers/stocky knees and leather boots naturally where the desk concealed them. Image2 is the existing approved seated actor sheet: use exactly this Borrin identity/body proportions/chair/boot quality and matching camera/scale, but image1's different looking-down and leaning phases and empty pointing fingers.
His anatomical RIGHT index finger (image LEFT) traces down an imaginary OPEN ledger page at the ORIGINAL image1 tabletop height. Left palm and fingers (image RIGHT) rest at the ORIGINAL imaginary right-page height. Do not move either hand down onto his lap, grip anything, add a quill, or turn the fingertips into fists. Keep right pointing finger extended and left fingers relaxed over imaginary page. Frame1 begins with finger at upper page, frames2-3 trace a short entry down the page, frames4-5 lean down to read, frames6-7 straighten, frame8 finishes pointing at the entry. Maintain small smooth pose changes and the SAME seated floor/body size, steady boots, head readable in all8. No changing chair scale or view. This is a finite one-entry review, not a walk, dance or broad gesture.
Transparent background, generous gutters around all8 whole figures, no desk/table/book/ink/quill/coins/tools/shadows/text/scenery. Semi-realistic detailed production render identical to current Borrin asset, clean natural edges. No duplicated poses. Author all eight together.
method: Built-in whole eight-pose edit, fixed camera and one shared physical scale; approved seated identity reference. Whole-cell extraction only.
scope: Candidate seated reference action at independently owned original desk. Native finger/page and stationary boot checks plus actual finite playback are required before approval.
